verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a real first-party JMAP API. It covers session discovery, token or OAuth auth, batched query/fetch/send calls, sync and push, and it is positioned to replace IMAP, CardDAV and CalDAV, so core mail operations are available programmatically. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches the UI feature for feature. missing for 10: documented API coverage of UI features such as filters/rules, Masked Email, aliases, scheduled send, snooze, templates and account settings; an explicit parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
